files.description: 170.315(b)(10) EHI Export documentation — 10-page PDF containing user guide for single-patient and population-level EHI export via the Export Batch CCDA function. Describes the ZIP export format (CCDA XML + CSV files for billing, demographics, scheduling, and document mapping). Version 2.0, dated October 24, 2023. No data dictionary, no field-level schemas, no sample files.
